mu_name_from: MuMain loads MODEL_DRAGON_KNIGHT_* from Data/Player/HDK_HelmMale01.bmd (ZzzOpenData.cpp:222-230; the helm is HDK_HelmMale 1). MU's group 7 number 29. Ours is named HelmMale30 by the index-plus-one rule every other set keeps: MU never loads a *Male30 file, so nothing collides, and the set tooling groups it by its Helm/Armor/... prefix.
why_this_one: The Blade Knight's level-380 set, Kanturu's gear (the user, 2026-10-22: 'we need to work on missing weapons and armors', then the four 380 sets and their weapons first, built on main and dormant until Kanturu drops them).

stats.note: The item's own row: OpenMU's Season 6 initialiser (Season 2's level-380 sets; 0.75 and 0.95d have none).
stats.drops_from_monsters_note: Dormant: MU drops it in Kanturu, which is not on main yet. Built, worn and cooked, but no monster leaves it until the map ships (the user, 2026-10-22: 'Dormant until Kanturu'). Its drop level is MU's.
stats.requires_note: MU asks level 380 (OpenMU's levelRequirement). Left at 0 for now: the user, 2026-10-22, settles it with Kanturu's levels ('Formula, decide later').
stats.class_level_note: The Blade Knight's alone: OpenMU's darkKnightClassLevel 2, not the third class. sim::fits asks Wearer::second (docs/game/second-class-gear.md).

sheet_from: MuMain/src/bin/Data/Player blackdrager_*.OZJ, decoded with pipeline/decode_texture.py: dark gunmetal plate traced in gold, a touch of orange.
material_note: painted_steel, as Great Dragon's: dark plate with its gold painted on. plate_steel on a dark sheet read as polished black with white blowouts (Dark Phoenix, 2026-10-04).
material_overrides_note: painted_steel's own grain is a blade's, brushed along V; on plate it drew vertical streaks (studio, 2026-10-04). plate_steel's cast grain instead, the paint left as it is.
effects_note: MuMain has no render arm for MODEL_DRAGON_KNIGHT_* (no ItemObjectAttribute glow, no chrome pass; its only other use is GMNewTown's display NPC): drawn as its sheet.
